name: com.midtrans.sdk.uikit.views.creditcard.bankpoints.BankPointsActivity
description: When a user selects BNI or Mandiri credit-card reward-point payments in Midtrans UiKit checkout, this screen shows the available bank points and lets the user apply them to the credit-card payment.
disableEffect: Disabling it can prevent users from completing payments with BNI or Mandiri credit-card reward-point payments.
